title: Core coefficient squares for relative-product factors
statement: Fix the data of the coefficient-factor theorem and an admissible coefficient comparison A. For compactifications cg and ch, the recursively defined coefficient isomorphisms satisfy A.FactorSquares cg ch: each of the six displayed factor natural transformations commutes with its coefficient comparison.

source.place: Expand each displayed factor into the primitive composition, projection, exchange, and tensor maps. Apply the four primitive coefficient equations of RelativeProductCoefficientData, use naturality and tensor bifunctoriality to paste the recursively defined object comparisons, and use inverse-square cancellation for inverse factors. The six component equations are exactly FactorSquares.
